entities.summary: Frank Kendall III is an American engineer, lawyer and executive who served as the 26th United States secretary of the Air Force from 2021 to 2025. He has served in several senior positions in the U.S. Department of Defense. A West Point graduate, he retired as a lieutenant colonel from the U.S. Army Reserve. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Frank Kendall III was a legal figures from Pittsfield (b. 1949-01-26, Pittsfield). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
